root_cause.text: The macro FAN_FROM_REG evaluates its arguments (val and div) multiple times, leading to TOCTOU race conditions in lockless contexts where shared driver data (fan_min, fan_div) can change between evaluations, potentially causing a divide-by-zero error when the divisor becomes zero.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "The macro FAN_FROM_REG evaluates its arguments multiple times. When used in lockless contexts involving shared driver data, this leads to Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) race conditions, potentially causing divide-by-zero errors." The patch converts the macro to a static function and moves the min calculation inside the lock in store_fan_div to ensure consistent data.
